item.title: Total reports by account and currency
item.brief: Implement the reports side of the shared currency contract: parse ledger CSV with a currency column and total amount_cents by account and currency; retain compatibility with legacy CSV lacking currency by treating all rows as USD; reject malformed currency codes (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters) with an error on stderr and exit 2; output CSV header account,currency,total_cents, sorted by account then currency. Add or update tests, keep existing python3 -m unittest passing, update the README, and commit the change in this repository.

item.title: Add optional currency column to ledger TSV/CSV
item.brief: Implement the ledger side of the shared currency contract: parse an optional fourth TSV column as an ISO 4217 code constrained to exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, default missing currency to USD, emit CSV header date,account,amount_cents,currency and currency per row, and report malformed currency with input line number to stderr and exit 2 while preserving exit 1 for other input errors. Add or update tests, keep existing cargo test passing, update the README, and commit the change in this repository.
